name: Neo-Neon Holdings Limited
summary: Neo-Neon Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company primarily involved in the entire lifecycle of lighting products, from their initial research and development to manufacturing, distribution, and ultimate sale. The firm serves a global clientele, with significant operations across North America, Europe, the People's Republic of China, and other Asian markets. Its business activities are structured into two main divisions: PRC Lighting and USA Lighting. Neo-Neon's product range features a diverse array of decorative and commercial LED lighting solutions. These offerings include popular items like neon flex, tape lights, LED light strings, duralight, party lights, flexible LED wall washers, dewdrop lights, and various vintage-style illumination products. In addition to its core lighting business, the company also provides money lending services and actively trades in lighting goods. Established in 1978, Neo-Neon Holdings Limited is headquartered in Hung Hom, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of THTF Energy Saving Holdings Limited.
